dataset: Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal Dataset v1
acquisition_type: native-resolution rectangular window export from original public cloud-optimized GeoTIFF; not the full global or regional tile
vertical_quantity: predicted height above ground in metres, not ellipsoid/orthometric ground or roof elevation
license: Dual CC-BY-4.0 / ODbL-1.0 per Google dataset page; retain Google Research attribution and coexist with Overture ODbL attribution
statistic: Median of predicted height pixels within each complete source footprint where building presence >=0.5 and height within 0–100 m. No reprojection/resampling. P10/P90 describe spatial model outputs, not statistical confidence intervals.
mask_threshold_status: 0.5 is a declared processing assumption, not a site-calibrated threshold
limitations: Predicted, not surveyed heights; Global South/tall-building uncertainty is explicitly documented by the provider.
Reported evaluation MAE is not a Bengaluru-specific accuracy guarantee.
2023 height predictions and 2026 source footprints may be non-contemporaneous or misregistered.
0.5 m stored raster pixels do not imply 0.5 m independently resolved height information.
Trees and non-building artifacts may affect predictions; presence threshold and manual evidence matter.
A footprint-level median need not represent the top of a tall or multi-part building.
All model_height_m remain null pending manual review; no missing value is automatically filled.
